## Claims
- [source-backed] The 2024 paper defines bigrassmannians \(v_{r,s,t,n}\in S_n\) by \(1\le t\le r,s\le n\), \(t>r+s-n\), and defines \(J_v=\operatorname{Span}_{\mathbb Z}\{\sigma_u:u\ge v\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 68-83]
- [source-backed] Its coefficient ring is \(\Lambda=\Lambda(x_1,x_2,\ldots)\) over \(\mathbb Z\), with \(I_{r,n-r}=\operatorname{Span}_{\mathbb Z}\{s_\lambda:\lambda\nsubseteq(n-r)^r\}\), \(\overline\Lambda=\Lambda/I_{r,n-r}\), and \(H^*(\mathrm{Gr}_{r,n})\cong\overline\Lambda\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 89-94]
- [source-backed] Theorem 1.2 sets \(i=s-t+1\), \(j=r-t+1\), \(a=\min(n-r-i,r-j)\), \(b=\min(i,j)\), and proves that \(J_v\subset\overline\Lambda\) is minimally generated by \(\{\overline{s}_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq(i^j,b^a)\}\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 95-110]
- [source-backed] The other 2011 family is \(\{\overline{s}_\mu:i^j\subseteq\mu\subseteq((i+a)^b,i^{j-b})\}\), but the 2024 text presents it only in Remark 4.7 and says its minimality “could” be proved by transposing the arguments; it is not included in the stated Theorem 1.2. [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 503-512]
- [source-backed] The 2011 stronger proposed statement is, for \(M=J_{v_{r,s,t,n}}\) over integral symmetric functions, \(M/\Lambda_+M\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}}\); the authors explicitly state that proof had eluded them. [source-2, lines 1536-1552]
- [source-backed] The stronger statement is not merely minimality: it asserts torsion-freeness and the exact free-abelian structure of indecomposables. The 2024 theorem statement contains no assertion about \(J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\). [doi:10.1112/jlms.12832, lines 95-110]

## Strategy
The requested source-refresh certificate is established. It identifies the exact integral setting, hypotheses, definitions, and theorem-level family in the 2024 full text, and distinguishes the second family as a transpose remark rather than part of that theorem.

The stronger integral indecomposables statement is **not established** by this 2024 theorem-level evidence. No parent proof was attempted.

## Gaps
The supplied 2024 full text does not state
\[
J_v/\Lambda_+J_v\cong\mathbb Z^{\binom{a+b}{a}},
\]
nor does its stated Theorem 1.2 explicitly prove minimality of the transposed family.
